title: S3 upload stores HANA metadata and one object
runtime: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry / XSUAA / HANA Cloud / S3
testCommand: Browser Control authenticated same-origin OData draft upload plus bounded Cloud Foundry HANA readback
actualResult: An authenticated PM created one draft attachment (HTTP 201), uploaded 131 sanitized bytes through the attachment content endpoint (HTTP 204), and activated the draft. HANA stored exactly one metadata row and S3 returned the same 131-byte object without exposing a credential or storage URL.
assertions: Draft attachment metadata create returned HTTP 201.
S3-backed content PUT returned HTTP 204 for 131 sanitized bytes.
HANA task 28 read back exactly one active metadata row with the expected filename, MIME type and file size.
Authenticated content GET returned HTTP 200 without exposing a provider credential or private storage URL.
limitations: The generated Fiori attachment toolbar remained disabled in edit mode and the active table did not render the persisted row. The accepted backend integration path therefore used the same authenticated browser session and standard OData attachment endpoints; the UI defect requires separate remediation.
